> A.B.G is a digital marketing agency owned by Aviel, specializing exclusively in marketing for real estate agents. The agency manages advertising campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and Google, with a focus on content writing and creative production designed to generate high-quality leads. The niche focus on real estate agents positions the brand as a specialized expert rather than a generalist agency, conveying authority and deep understanding of the real estate market.

A.B.G is a digital marketing agency owned by Aviel, specializing exclusively in marketing for real estate agents. The agency manages advertising campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and Google, with a focus on content writing and creative production designed to generate high-quality leads.
